incident-bot: ALERT: eval-sentinel triggered for prod-gen v2. Metric: output_drift_score crossed threshold (0.42 -> 0.77). Severity: P3. Paging on-call. See eval dashboard: https://console.redwood/evals/alerts/1998002468 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created (INC-8452). Initial page sent to Carmen (oncall).

Carmen (oncall): acked. I'm taking this. Can someone paste the failing prompt bucket?

Liam (mlops): I pulled the gated-evals run — spike concentrated on the "safety_catchall_v2" prompt set. Error: higher hallucination rate and profanity score drift. Quick paste of top diffs:
```
- prompt_id: saf-1245
  baseline: 0.03 hallucination
  current: 0.27 hallucination
- prompt_id: saf-1270
  baseline: 0.01 profanity
  current: 0.22 profanity
```

Anjali (prod): Is this hitting customer traffic or just internal evals?

Liam (mlops): It's reflected in production traffic for the gen-v2 route — evaluation sampling shows 0.9% of live requests failing the safety gate in the last 10m (baseline ~0.05%).

Sasha (support): We're getting 2 incoming tickets flagged as "inappropriate output" from customer acme-corp about 10:20 PDT. Triage in progress.

Carmen (oncall): Ok mitigation plan: 1) apply eval-gate block to v2 for safety category; 2) route new chat requests to gen-v1 variant for 10m; 3) start investigation runbooks. Liam, can you cut the gate and routing?

Liam (mlops): On it. Running commands now:
```
# block v2 on safety eval gate
infractl eval-gate set --model prod-gen-v2 --gate safety --action block --reason "auto: output_drift"
# create traffic rule
infractl route add --from "route:prod/chat" --to "model:prod-gen-v1" --priority 100 --ttl 600
```

incident-bot: ACTIONS: eval-gate updated, routing rule created. Traffic shift ~92% -> v1 within 90s.

Carmen (oncall): Confirming traffic shift in console traces. Latency/generation metrics normal. Any sign this is a config/serving regression or model weights change?

Liam (mlops): No deploys in the last 24h to prod-gen-v2. The model artifact checksum matches staged artifact. Suspecting recent quantization tweak rolled out in infra on a subset of nodes 2h ago. Opening infra ticket.

Anjali (prod): Flagging for product: Maria, FYI — possible customer-visible safety regression on gen-v2. We're routing to v1 for safety; will update SRE and legal if more customers report.

Maria (pm): Thanks — adding to the customer-impact tracker and notifying account team for acme-corp. Please keep me posted on severity changes.

Sasha (support): I've replied to acme-corp with temporary mitigation note and ETA 30m; will update if we see more reports.

Carmen (oncall): Next steps: 1) Liam to validate infra node quantization revert; 2) run targeted evals across the failing prompt set; 3) if root cause confirmed, either hotfix/rollback infra or model patch. Assigning owners: Liam (mlops) + Carmen (coord).

Liam (mlops): Started a focused eval job with increased sampling (10k queries) — results ETA ~12m. Also rolling back quantization change on suspect nodes now; patch ID infra-qz-2026.

incident-bot: update: PagerDuty INC-8452 status -> acknowledged by Carmen.

Carmen (oncall): Update at +15: eval job shows failure rate falling on v2 after rolling back quantization on suspect nodes (current safety-fail rate 0.08). Keeping gate blocked until we hit baseline <0.06 for 30m.

Maria (pm): Good. Please prepare a short customer-facing blurb for account team.

Sasha (support): Draft: "We detected anomalous outputs on gen-v2 and temporarily routed traffic to gen-v1 while we mitigated. We are monitoring and will notify once restored." Will send.

Carmen (oncall): I'll keep this thread updated. If anything degrades push to INC-8452 and escalate to P2. Closing immediate page for now; leaving gate/routing in place until postmortem.

incident-bot: NOTE: Please run postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/postmortem-template and tag #eng-ml #eng-runtime.

Liam (mlops): filing infra ticket INFRA-4021 and postmortem draft.

Carmen (oncall): last check @ 1998002745: safety-fail rate steady at 0.05 on v2 after full rollback; unblocking plan: hold 30m, then gradual re-enable with 10% traffic increments and monitor.

Maria (pm): Thanks all.

Sasha (support): Will update acme-corp once we re-enable. :white_check_mark:
